verify_extension_handle: verify that a given extension handle is a valid FieldDescriptor for a protobuf message
get_extension_value: get the current value of a protobuf message extension field using the extension handle as a key
set_extension_value: set the value of a non-repeated scalar protobuf extension field using the extension handle
find_extension_by_name: find a known protobuf extension field descriptor by its full name in the message descriptor pool
find_extension_by_number: find a known protobuf extension field descriptor by its field number in the message descriptor pool
